message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you agree on). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round. | | **Setup** | • 108‑card deck (standard Uno deck).
• Each player draws 7 cards.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches the discard pile’s **color**, **number**, or **symbol**.
• If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile.
• If that drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two (+2)** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – you choose the new color and the next player draws four cards. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk a challenge.) | | **Wild Draw Four Challenge** | If a player believes the previous player illegally played a +4, they can challenge.
• The challenged player must show their hand.
• If they had a playable color card, the challenger draws six cards (instead of four) and the +4 is discarded.
• If they had no playable color card, the challenger draws four cards and the +4 stays in play. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn.
• If you forget and another player points it out before the next turn starts, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card.
• That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by the other players: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach the agreed‑upon score (commonly 500) wins. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep track of the current color** – even if a Wild was played, the next player must match that color unless they play another Wild. 2. **Use Draw Two/Draw Four strategically** – stack them if you’re allowed (some house rules let players stack +2 or +4 on top of each other). 3. **Watch for “UNO”** – it’s a common source of penalties and can change the outcome of a round. 4. **Plan your hand** – try to keep a mix of colors and action cards so you’re not stuck. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
